62c2ad292705cf6714a93f82625fed4a5fa340f5.summary: Mandiant (FireEye) analysis of the CARBANAK data-stealing backdoor, drawing on 220 samples. It describes the backdoor's monitoring threads, its 34 commands, its configuration file, and its two C2 protocols (pseudo-HTTP and a custom binary protocol) and how the binary protocol changed over time. The report attributes the activity to the FIN7 threat group and to a possibly loosely connected 'Carbanak Group'. It says FIN7 targeted U.S. restaurant and hospitality firms, and that the wider campaigns hit banks and financial institutions in the U.S., Middle East, Asia and Eastern Europe. It also…
